name: midigitalexpansion-crm
description: Internal CRM for MiDigitalExpansion — built to make service-ladder progression and MRR impossible to forget. Runs entirely on Cloudflare: Workers, D1, R2 and Cron Triggers.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run ensure:deps && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.deploy: npm run build --prefix client && npm run deploy --prefix server
scripts.cf:build: npm run ensure:deps && npm run build --prefix client && npm run codegen --prefix server
